_comment: Station, camera model and objects for the HUD. Heights are metres above sea level (top of object). Edit freely; the page reloads it every 5 min.

station._pos_note: antenna position from user (Google Maps) 2026-10-11; ground 117.7 m (GUGiK NMT); antenna 15 m above ground (user) -> h = 132.7 m ASL

camera._comment: hfov: rectilinear-equivalent at image centre (measured 34.6 px/deg @2560). pitch: camera tilt, deg (+up). az_offset: true az of image centre = rotator az + az_offset. az_delay: video lags rotctld by this (s).
camera._lens_note: 2026-10-11 night: lens distortion fitted from 4700 SIFT matches between frames at rotator 97..142 deg (tools/calib/distortion.py, NPP=2: optical centre free, rms 0.049 deg; rectilinear model was 0.59 deg and put objects 3.4 deg too far out at 30 deg off-centre). Roll fitted +1.26.
camera._pitch_note: 2026-10-11: Sky Tower top (el 1.75) at y=854 of 1920 -> -1.3 deg
camera._az_offset_note: 2026-10-11 09:25 UTC: rotator recalibrated in K3NG (\A122 + \Q while pointing at Sky Tower, true 121.95). Before: rotctld read ~18.8 deg low.

objects.name: Sky Tower
objects.src: top red aviation light 215 m above ground (user) + ground 120.5 m (GUGiK NMT); OSM way 165880544

objects.name: Ślęża RTCN
objects.src: OSM node 794745107 (136 m tower near 718 m summit)

objects.name: EC Wrocław chimney
objects.src: Kogeneracja / PGE EC Wrocław, tallest chimney: OSM way 301417638 (height 186 m) + ground 115.9 m (GUGiK NMT). Top light not yet confirmed by camera (2026-10-11 night: a blinking light at az 90.3 el ~3.9 is something else, likely a closer crane)

objects.name: GSM mast Alba
objects.src: user, Google Maps 2026-10-11 (= OSM node 6142939720); ground 116.7 m (GUGiK NMT); top measured by camera: 153.1 m ASL (~36 m above ground)

_beacons_note: 23 cm beacons come from /telemetry/beacons (IARU list, merged daily by the telemetry service; dropped only when QRT or unreported > 90 days)
_summits_note: SOTA summits come from /telemetry/summits (computed by the telemetry service from the station location; SOTA_ASSOCIATIONS / SUMMIT_MAX_KM in .env)

display._comment: title: shown after the call sign in the bar; layers.<name>: "on" (shown) | "off" (button, hidden at start) | "disabled" (no button, data not loaded). video_lag_s: camera->browser latency (aircraft/satellite positions are shown for that moment); geoid_n_m: geoid height above WGS84 at the station (ADS-B GPS altitude is ellipsoidal); adsb_max_km: farther aircraft are hidden (?adsbkm= overrides)
